mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.5% and remains there for two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline during periods of sustained RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and profit pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains there for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
